description_en: Updates the execution script of a job
name: UpdateJobScript

parameters.help_en: The job ID. You can obtain the ID on the Tasks page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespaces page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Applications page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the script version
parameters.name: version_description

parameters.example:
#!/bin/bash

# The following are built-in variables provided by the system to retrieve job runtime information
echo "Job parameters: #{schedulerx.jobParameters}"
echo "Sharding ID: #{schedulerx.shardingId}"
echo "Sharding parameters: #{schedulerx.shardingParameters}"
echo "Total shards: #{schedulerx.shardingNum}"
echo "Retry attempts: #{schedulerx.attempt}"
echo "Trigger type: #{schedulerx.triggerType}"
echo "Schedule timestamp: #{schedulerx.scheduleTime}"
echo "Data timestamp: #{schedulerx.dataTime}"

# The last line of output will be returned as the result
echo "hello world"

# exit 1 indicates failure
exit 0
parameters.name: script_content
